description: This source file defines a class GraphicsFromImage which provides functionality to draw on an image and save it as a PNG file. The class includes a static method Test1 that demonstrates creating an image, drawing shapes, and saving the result.

classes.name: GraphicsFromImage
classes.description: A class providing methods to create and manipulate graphics on images for demonstration purposes in the PdfSharp framework.

methods.name: Test1
methods.description: Creates a bitmap image, draws lines and an ellipse, and saves it as a PNG file.
